pillar_reactions.evidence: No pillar was delivered. The call ended at 00:05:31 with no offer, no philosophy walkthrough and no product of any kind presented. The only description given was of the delivery model, in response to the prospect's confusion: 'It's not like you have to be on Zoom call with us when you're working out. We just kind of guide you.'
Never delivered. Nutrition was not mentioned at any point by either party.

Never delivered as a pillar. Its underlying value was never argued, despite the prospect's problem being a two-year failure to restart on his own — he actually asserted the opposite unchallenged: 'I have no problem doing this stuff kind of on my own.'

unmet_demand.want: A low-commitment way to learn and copy Trevor's kettlebell movements — the thing he thought he was signing up for
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He described it in his first sentence — 'I was just kind of just more thinking maybe I can just learn and mimic some of his movements with the kettlebell' — which is a near-exact description of the $200/month self-guided product. That product was never mentioned. The same rep volunteered it unprompted to three other prospects in the same batch, all of whom were more affluent and more self-directed than this one. Nothing about the product prevents serving this demand; it simply was not offered.

unmet_demand.want: A programme that survives a completely unpredictable schedule with twin toddlers — training that fits into whatever time actually appears, rather than time he has to protect in advance
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He raised it as his primary reason for hesitating and it was answered only by clarifying that sessions are not live. Whether the programme flexes around a day that collapses was never addressed, and it is the specific reassurance he needed.

unmet_demand.want: Confidence that a torn bicep and ongoing body aches will not be re-aggravated by kettlebell training
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The injury and the aches were both disclosed and neither was acknowledged. No screening exists, and here not even a question was asked, so the prospect left with the same uncertainty he arrived with. Flagged as unvalidated rather than a product gap because nothing was ever proposed to him.
